repairability_score.note: Broad category estimate: Standard notebook architecture with modular storage and memory.

battery.note: Broad category estimate for replacement laptop battery pack in India market.

ssd.note: Broad category estimate for standard M.2 NVMe SSD replacement (512GB-1TB).

ram.note: Broad category estimate for standard DDR4/DDR5 SO-DIMM memory upgrade/replacement.

keyboard.note: Broad category estimate for replacement laptop keyboard assembly.

thermals.note: Broad category estimate for thermal paste repaste and cooling fan cleaning/service.

display.note: Broad category estimate for 14-15.6 inch 1080p replacement display panel.

motherboard.note: Broad category estimate for system logic board component repair or replacement.

expected_useful_life.note: Broad category estimate: Standard consumer/commercial notebook useful life baseline.

working_a_grade.note: Broad category estimate for working A-grade refurbished laptop.

working_b_grade.note: Broad category estimate for working B-grade refurbished laptop with minor cosmetic wear.

parts_salvage.note: Broad category estimate for salvage value of functional modular components (RAM, SSD, screen).
